mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_bge_m3 (id, kb_id, doc_id, content, chunk_hash, index_fingerprint, chunk_index, document_version, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(CAST(#{id} AS uuid), gen_random_uuid()), CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), CAST(#{docId} AS uuid), #{content}, #{chunkHash}, #{indexFingerprint}, #{chunkIndex}, #{documentVersion}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{embedding}::vector, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, doc_id, content, chunk_hash, index_fingerprint, chunk_index, document_version, metadata::text AS metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
DELETE FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE doc_id = CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid) ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE chunk_bge_m3
kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid),
doc_id = CAST(#{docId} AS uuid),
content = #{content},
chunk_hash = #{chunkHash},
index_fingerprint = #{indexFingerprint},
chunk_index = #{chunkIndex},
document_version = #{documentVersion},
metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb),
embedding = #{embedding}::vector,
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, c.doc_id, d.source_key, c.content, c.chunk_hash, c.index_fingerprint, c.chunk_index, c.document_version, c.metadata::text AS metadata, c.embedding, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 c JOIN document d ON d.id = c.doc_id WHERE c.kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND c.index_fingerprint = #{indexFingerprint} ORDER BY c.embedding <-> #{vectorLiteral}::vector LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, c.doc_id, d.source_key, c.content, c.chunk_hash, c.index_fingerprint, c.chunk_index, c.document_version, c.metadata::text AS metadata, c.embedding, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chunk_bge_m3 c JOIN document d ON d.id = c.doc_id WHERE c.kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND c.index_fingerprint = #{indexFingerprint} AND c.content ||| #{query} ORDER BY pdb.score(c.id) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
